name: MAT267H1 — Socratic Discovery (Nonlinear Systems and Phase Portraits)
description: For 2D x'=f(x,y), y'=g(x,y), we draw the phase portrait. Fixed points: f=g=0. Linearize near each: Jacobian J. Eigenvalues of J determine LOCAL behavi

steps.template_en: For 2D x'=f(x,y), y'=g(x,y), we draw the phase portrait. Fixed points: f=g=0. Linearize near each: Jacobian J. Eigenvalues of J determine LOCAL behavior.
steps.template_zh: 对2D x'=f(x,y), y'=g(x,y)，画相图。不动点：f=g=0。附近线性化：雅可比J。J的特征值决定局部行为。

steps.template_en: x'=y, y'=-x: J=[[0,1],[-1,0]], eigenvalues ±i → CENTER (closed orbits). x'=y, y'=x: eigenvalues ±1 → SADDLE. Stability determined by REAL PART of eigenvalues.
steps.template_zh: x'=y, y'=-x: J=[[0,1],[-1,0]], 特征值±i→中心。x'=y, y'=x: 特征值±1→鞍点。稳定性由特征值实部决定。

steps.template_en: Classification: (1) Real λ₁>0>λ₂ → saddle. (2) Both negative → stable node. (3) Both positive → unstable node. (4) Complex Re<0 → stable spiral. (5) Complex Re>0 → unstable spiral. (6) Purely imaginary → center (Hartman-Grobman needed).
steps.template_zh: 分类：(1)实λ₁>0>λ₂→鞍。(2)都负→稳定结点。(3)都正→不稳定结点。(4)复Re<0→稳定螺旋。(5)复Re>0→不稳定螺旋。(6)纯虚→中心(需Hartman-Grobman)。

steps.template_en: Hartman-Grobman: If NO eigenvalues on imaginary axis (hyperbolic fixed point), the nonlinear system is LOCALLY TOPOLOGICALLY CONJUGATE to the linearized system. Phase portrait near fixed point looks the same.
steps.template_zh: Hartman-Grobman：若无虚轴特征值(双曲不动点)，非线性系统局部拓扑共轭于线性化系统。不动点附近相图相同。

steps.template_en: For x'=y, y'=-x-x²: (1) Find all fixed points. (2) Linearize at each. (3) Classify. (4) Nonlinear term x² breaks center — what happens? (5) Use Poincaré-Bendixson for limit cycles.
steps.template_zh: 对x'=y, y'=-x-x²：(1)找所有不动点。(2)在每个点线性化。(3)分类。(4)非线性项x²破坏中心？(5)用Poincaré-Bendixson找极限环。

steps.template_en: Poincaré-Bendixson: in 2D, bounded trajectory not approaching a fixed point → LIMIT CYCLE. Only in 2D — in 3D+ you get CHAOS (strange attractors). Why weather prediction is fundamentally limited.
steps.template_zh: Poincaré-Bendixson：2D中不趋于不动点的有界轨迹→极限环。只在2D成立——3D+得混沌(奇异吸引子)。天气预测的根本局限。
